description: Work out UK alcohol units in a drink from its ABV (percentage) and volume (millilitres), using units = ABV x ml / 1000. Optionally give the number of those drinks per week to get a weekly total compared against the NHS low risk guideline of 14 units a week. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/alcohol-unit-calculator/

abv.description: Alcohol by volume as a percentage, e.g. 12 for 12% wine

drinksPerWeek.description: Optional number of these drinks per week, to work out a weekly units total

ml.description: Volume of the drink in millilitres, e.g. 175 for a medium glass of wine

name: hopi_alcohol_unit_calculator

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Alcohol unit calculator
